prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Cobalt and Chalk: page #FFFFFF, text #132349, accent #164AC6, secondary surface #E8EFFC, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in EB Garamond; institutional sans heading with literary body. Composition: Full-width relevant image with heading overlay, visible next section, no text/media split hero. Use body 20px, heading 48px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
